newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin signs decree on foreigners' Gazprom shares.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin signs decree on foreigners' Gazprom shares.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin has signed a decree covering the ownership by foreigners of shares in giant gas monopoly Gazprom, the Kremlin said on Wednesday.
"Yes, the decree is signed," a Kremlin official said by telephone. He was unable to give details immediately.
A Gazprom official said earlier that he had seen a copy of the decree.
"If it is released in the version that I saw, foreign investors, non-residents, may not buy shares on the domestic market," Eduard Ivanov, head of Gazprom's securities department, told Reuters.
